annotations.title: Call a REST API from its OpenAPI document

description: Turn a public OpenAPI document into tools you can call, or call one of its endpoints (action list_tools only reads the document; action call sends the request). A call sends the HTTP method the document declares, including POST, PUT or DELETE, to that public API without credentials, so it can change data there. Use when the API you need has an OpenAPI document but no MCP server. Example arguments: {"spec_url": "https://api.example.org/openapi.json", "action": "list_tools"}

action.description: Action: 'list_tools' to discover executable tools, 'call' to invoke an endpoint.

base_url.description: Optional override for API base URL.

spec_url.description: URL of the OpenAPI/Swagger JSON specification.

tool.description: Tool name to execute when action='call'.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: adapt_rest

outputSchema.description: Structured tool result. Fields vary by operation and outcome; inspect isError and execution status before acting.

visitor.description: Session transport only. Never include identity or tokens in answer text.

token.description: Opaque continuation credential; send only in the session transport.
